facts.text: I am trying to find a good spot for my new succulent.

I have a snake plant that has started to grow new leaves.

My spider plant is thriving after moving it to the kitchen window.
I have a basil plant on the balcony.
My basil plant is getting too much direct sunlight.

I want low-maintenance plants that are good for beginners.
I think I will go with the fern.
I am planning to get a plant tracking app to keep track of my plants' watering schedules and fertilization reminders.
